findings.claim: The checked-in generated iOS Xcode build phase still inherits registry credentials because its shell script does not unset them.
findings.evidence: The remediation criterion says "The iOS Xcode script unsets the same variables before invoking Tauri/Cargo" and the `trust-boundaries-fail-closed` constraint requires credential boundaries to fail closed, but the generated `PBXShellScriptBuildPhase` has `shellScript = "RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable pnpm tauri ios xcode-script ...";` with no `unset CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN NPM_TOKEN NODE_AUTH_TOKEN`; only `gen/apple/project.yml` contains the unset.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate or patch the checked-in `.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` so the actual Xcode build phase begins with `unset CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN NPM_TOKEN NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` before invoking `pnpm tauri ios xcode-script`, and make the verifier inspect the generated pbxproj as well as `project.yml`.
